reason: I already go out most weeks and I am sick of finding out about things two days late on someone's story. If everything is actually in one place with real dates, I will use it, and if a concert ticket costs the same 700 Lek as at the door, I would buy it there once to see it works.
objection: Will this app still be alive in three months? Every Tirana app starts loud and dies quiet, and 'complete feed' is a big promise — the first week I open it and half the events I know about are missing, I delete it.
would_change_my_mind: Nothing to flip me to no right now, but to keep me: the feed has to really be complete for two or three weeks in a row, and I need to see people I know going.
